title: Find the last occurrence of a word
description: Write a function `last_occurrence(text, word)` that returns the index of the last occurrence of `word` in `text`, using `rindex()`.
examples:
last_occurrence(
    'You cannot end a sentence with because because because is a conjunction',
    'because',
)
-> 47
hints: text.rindex(word) is to .index() what .rfind() is to .find() - it searches from the end, and raises an error rather than returning -1 if there's no match.
Call .rindex() on text with word and return the result.
expected_behavior: Returns the index where word last appears in text.

hidden_tests.call: last_occurrence('You cannot end a sentence with because because because is a conjunction', 'because')

explanation: rindex() combines rfind()'s backward search direction with index()'s error-on-no-match behavior.
